text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is overcome with<n>frustration after failing
to leave her<n>mark on the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan, however, fights through<n>the
frustration and addresses her<n>fans, making a
rousing declaration<n>that reinvigorates not only them
but<n>herself as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing this, Ines senses that Mejiro<n>Ryan is on
another level from her, and<n>begins to seriously
consider the way<n>she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In part to determine whether she has<n>what it takes
to reach Ryan's level,<n>Ines decides to throw herself
into<n>training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
